nina: Heads-up - HelixGrid sent a credit memo that didn't reference the original PO so AP routed it to vendor team, not ENG. Invoice/CM 50188. Can someone advise?
omar: Do we have the original PO number?
nina: PO 3347 was the original for the engagement (ENG-INFRA). CM PDF only lists their invoice ref, not the PO.
ap-bot: System: Credit Memo 50188 ingested with status NEEDS_PO_MATCH at 2026-04-06T11:02:15Z.
felix: If it's a credit against PO 3347 we should match it and route to eng-infra approvers. AP supports manual linking.
omar: I can attach PO 3347 and set GL to 6002. Nina, confirm amount and reason code?
nina: Confirmed: credit for $1,200, reason: overcharge adjustment. Use reason code ADJ-COST.
omar: Done - linked PO 3347, set GL 6002, reason ADJ-COST. Status PENDING_APPROVAL and approver eng-infra-approvers@redwood.com.
ap-bot: Audit: User omar linked PO 3347 to CM 50188 and updated status to PENDING_APPROVAL at 2026-04-06T11:04:50Z.
felix: Please add a vendor note and ask HelixGrid to include PO on future credits. We'll also add a rule to fuzzy-match invoices to POs by invoice date/amount.
nina: I'll open a vendor ops ticket and cc accounts payable. Filing #SUP-4892.
omar: Quick follow-up: adding a one-time exception so credit clears against outstanding invoice in same pay cycle.
ap-bot: Payment allocation: ALLOCATED_TO_INVOICE 49012 by omar at 2026-04-06T11:06:30Z.
felix: Thanks all, closing after approval.
nina: Closing.
